terbaru.judul: Universality and Heterogeneity of Stylized Facts in Cryptocurrency and Equity Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze one-minute data (2020--2025) for Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and E-mini S\&P~500 futures using the Complexity--Entropy Causality Plane (CECP) and directed horizontal visibility graphs (DHVG).

terbaru.judul: Beyond Forecasting: Recasting Volatility Control as a Routing Problem
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose VolRouter, a modular framework that formulates volatility control as state-conditioned routing over estimator-controller pairs.

terbaru.pelajaran: We show that economic weight distribution across a partition, not hashrate majority, is the primary determinant of resolution under Bitcoin's operational retarget interval and moderate price divergence.

terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes an adaptive training controller for Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) RaQL and evaluates it on a daily Bitcoin trading task.

terbaru.pelajaran: We show the key decisions that must be made when modelling an economy with the DeTEcT framework and showcase some numerical methods that can be used in conjunction with the framework to perform economic simulations.

terbaru.judul: Bitcoin Runs on a Clock: Why Every Price Indicator Dies and the Halving Clock Doesn't
terbaru.pelajaran: Every widely followed Bitcoin cycle indicator (Pi Cycle, MVRV, Mayer, Puell) called turns precisely for a decade, then degraded in one sequence: precise, then early, then silent.

terbaru.judul: Near-Tight Theoretical Bounds for Incentive Compatibility in Bitcoin Mining
terbaru.pelajaran: When is honest Bitcoin mining rational?

We study the impact that two miners equipped with quantum computers purpose-built for quantum Bitcoin mining will have on the 51% attack threshold of the Bitcoin network, given that the miners are playing a competitive game against each other to be the first to mine a block.
